summary: The customer called to report that their home internet was down and asked if it was a general outage or an issue with their router. The agent verified the account number and informed the customer that there was a major fiber cut outage in the Jubeiha area being handled by technicians. Upon the customer's request, the agent added a free 5GB mobile data bundle as compensation, confirming it would be active within five minutes.
